'''''Headliner''''' was a [[YT-1220]], that was owned by the [[Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was used as an in-system [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and was piloted by [[Dellko]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]. The Council sent it to take the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to [[Oluna Biqua]], as they were going there for a luxury holiday. On arrival there, it was told to land at [[Port Epsilon]], which it did.
